signing.kind: Non-traded REIT subscription agreement (sample form): the investor completes sections 1 to 5 (pages 1-4; entity and co-investor blocks on page 2), initials the representations in a primary column with a co-investor column beside it (pages 8-11), consents to electronic delivery on page 7, and signs on page 12 with the co-investor or custodian beside; the custodian gives name, tax ID and phone on page 1; the financial advisor completes section 6 and signs with the branch manager on page 6. No issuer acceptance block.
